proposer_notes: Lap-24: clone of task_recipe_navigator + one paragraph at the top instructing the agent to make their FIRST call a graphify shape/summarize/navigate. Tests the priming-effect hypothesis — that structural data left in cache by early graphify calls makes later sub-tasks cheaper, on a chain of related questions (seed_task_006 session benchmark). Predicted to win measurably on calls and wall (the metrics that compound across a session) when run on session-shaped tasks; should be neutral or marginally win on single-task benchmarks where the priming effect doesn't compound.
